ADFH OMS Business Requirements Document, excerpt for testing (made up)

1. Customer tiers
The OMS supports four customer tiers: tenant, registered customer, walk in and government.
Each service charge can have a separate rate for each customer tier.

2. Wallet
Tenants top up a wallet through Maqta Pay and services are paid from the wallet balance.
The wallet screen should be user friendly and load fast.
Reports will include relevant data as needed.

3. Parking
Parking fees are charged per entry at the gate.
